policies.title: Cuban ordinary passports: Grenada visa-free visitor entry
policies.summary: Grenada's active embassy country schedule says Cuba requires no visa for a 60-day visit.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Cuban passport holder making a short visitor visit of up to 60 days.
The live embassy page links the April 2024 country schedule; recheck the schedule before travel for changes.
Work, residence, study, diplomatic, official and service passports, carrier requirements and final admission are outside this finding.
